measurementsRequired: Unique-geometry family at about 300,000 unique vertices, no placements: peak RSS, load and save time, frame time if the harness reports it, inference-index build and query time.

Any per-unique-vertex cost the measurements show that v2's materialized terms do not cover is added to the modeled worst case. If the total goes over 3 GiB, the numbers are reported and no other limit changes.
